save_tensor_to_file: save a PyTorch tensor or object to a .pt file using torch.save
load_checkpoint_from_file: load a saved PyTorch checkpoint from a file with optional map_location mapping
load_weights_only: load model weights safely from a checkpoint file using weights_only=True
register_custom_device_package: register custom tagger and deserializer for a new device type with register_package
set_default_load_endianness: set the fallback byte order for loading PyTorch serialization files
